what: Only the 1px ring around the plate catches a round glow at the cursor position (radius 100px, strong in the center, transparent at the edge). The glow trails the cursor by .1 of the remaining distance per frame and turns on only when the cursor is within 1000px of the plate, so approaching from outside softly lights the nearest edge first. Corners follow the plate’s border-radius

options.reach: Turn-on distance — draws when within this many px of the board box, default 1000
options.--fx-glow: Light color (css variable, on the panel or its ancestor) — falls back to --kf-accent if absent. To change the color in dark and light sections, change only this variable with a theme selector

note: The light color is re-read every 20 frames so it follows theme changes during scroll. Nothing is drawn on touch devices or with reduced motion. The canvas sits on top of the panel (z-index 2) and does not intercept pointer input.
